workstreams.objective: Benchmark near-launch Pyrnova against relevant direct and adjacent competitors, identify consequential capability gaps, and recommend additions that increase customer decision value without bloating Phase 1.
Compare Pyrnova's original concept/research/ideation with today's product and classify ambitions as achieved, deliberately deferred, accidentally lost, obsolete, or worth restoring.

Study relevant businesses including Palantir, Flock Safety, Anduril, Dataminr, Primer, Recorded Future, Govini, Second Front, Scale AI, Axon, Samsara, CrowdStrike and Cloudflare for company-building lessons.

Identify valuable Pyrnova applications outside defense, concentrating on markets where external change creates expensive decisions before conventional information environments explain the consequence.
Develop a professional networking system identifying customers, allies, experts, introducers, advisers and mutually beneficial non-competing relationships.
Identify associations, trade bodies, conferences, memberships and events that offer customer access, useful intelligence, partnerships or institutional credibility.
Define Pyrnova social presence including avatars, headers, company copy, platform profiles and asset requirements while preserving founder privacy doctrine.
Design monitoring for competitors, prospects, keywords, buying signals, relevant discussions and opportunities for useful engagement.
Define appropriate Phase 1 and future login, MFA, recovery, session, administrative access, SSO and SCIM architecture without unnecessary enterprise complexity.
Identify useful third-party software/services for sales, finance, support, documentation, security, analytics, communications, automation and operations while avoiding SaaS sprawl.
Define a defensible methodology for measuring how much useful decision time Pyrnova creates before a customer's conventional information environment reaches the same consequential conclusion.
Create a granular customer-acquisition and growth roadmap beyond the already-locked first-five sequence while preserving focus on collected revenue.
Identify non-competing businesses and professionals whose existing customer relationships or capabilities could accelerate Pyrnova adoption.
Map the people and organizations surrounding Pyrnova's buyers, including influencers, gatekeepers, advisers, partners, vendors and competitors.
Determine what can become genuinely defensible as Pyrnova grows from one customer to a scaled intelligence company.
Design a controlled system for researching, drafting, approving, scheduling and measuring Pyrnova social content.
Identify the smallest defensible security closure set required for Customer #1 production access.
Create a practical incident-response procedure appropriate to a founder-led Pyrnova Phase 1 deployment.
Define how Pyrnova operationally retains and removes customer, evidence, logging and derived data while respecting source rights and historical integrity.
Define the concrete operating procedure from signed and paid customer through activation, delivery, measurement and continuation.
Define a lightweight sales operating system that supports aggressive acquisition without turning Pyrnova into a CRM project.
Identify how an intelligent well-funded competitor could attack Pyrnova and which vulnerabilities warrant attention.
Identify the sequence of real achievements that can make Pyrnova increasingly credible to sophisticated customers without founder-profile theater.
Extract recurring company-building patterns from successful adjacent technology and intelligence businesses.
Explore how Pyrnova's own intelligence principles can identify organizations experiencing changes that create an immediate reason to buy Pyrnova.
